name: Linguistic Revival

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text: You achieved fluency in different languages with each reincarnation, and your brain remembers much of the grammar, idioms, and obscenities that you spouted in old lives. You gain Truespeech as a 5th-rank occult innate spell that you can cast once a day on only yourself. While the spell is active, you get a +2 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks while speaking to a creature in a language other than Common.
